title: Rollback review
description: Restore only proven writes that still match their recorded result. A conflict blocks every candidate field of that document. Other documents can still be restored.
acknowledge: I have reviewed the restorations, exclusions and conflicts.
none: No eligible restoration. Unknown outcomes require manual review; unchanged operations have no write to undo.
uncertain: Confirmation outcome is unknown. Check the original Job in History before proceeding.
selectiveHelp: Search and select up to 500 modified documents. Selection is kept across pages. The preview will recheck current values and permissions.
waitForPrevious: Finish or resume the previous rollback before creating another.
